يفتتحوا (form VIII)
# يَفْتَتِحُوا (yaftatiḥū) /jaf.ta.ti.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# يُفْتَتَحُوا (yuftataḥū) /juf.ta.ta.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
